definitions.content: The part of a measuring instrument that displays an indication.

notes.content: For a weighing instrument, the indicating device is the set of components which display the value, in units of mass, of the result of a weighing operation.
For filling instruments, the indicating device may indicate either the mass of the load or the difference between this mass and the preset value provided the intention is made clear.

definitions.content: Partie d'un instrument de mesure affichant une indication.
